import re

# Test more patterns
patterns = [
    (r'\s*(\S+)\s*', 'hello   world'),
    (r'\s*(\S+)\s*', '  hello  '),
    (r'\s*(\S+)\s*', 'hello'),
]

for p, s in patterns:
    m = re.search(p, s)
    if m:
        print(f"Pattern {p!r} on {s!r}: matched {m.group(1)!r}")
    else:
        print(f"Pattern {p!r} on {s!r}: no match")

print()
# What about center-align with padding?
center_patterns = [
    (r'\s*(.*?)\s*', 'hello   world'),
    (r'\s*(.*?)\s*', '  hello  '),
]

for p, s in center_patterns:
    m = re.search(p, s)
    if m:
        print(f"Center {p!r} on {s!r}: matched {m.group(1)!r}")
    else:
        print(f"Center {p!r} on {s!r}: no match")
PYEOF
